description: Enumerate EVERY candidate conversion route for an intent — from/to asset (DEPIX, USDT, LBTC, BTC, USDC) plus destination network — with per-leg fee/receipt estimates, single-hop AND multi-hop, custodial legs flagged. The SDK never ranks or picks: compare the candidates and pass your chosen route id to wallet_convert (the primary conversion surface). amount_sats is the FROM asset's BASE UNITS. Estimates are best-effort (null + a note when a leg cannot be pre-estimated). Opens short-lived provider quote streams but signs nothing — moves no money.

amount_sats.description: Amount in the asset's BASE UNITS (sats), as a decimal integer STRING. 1 DePix cent = 1,000,000 sats. Never pass a BRL value here.

from.description: Asset to convert FROM: DEPIX, USDT, LBTC (L-BTC), BTC or USDC.

from_network.description: ORIGIN network of `from`. Liquid assets default to liquid (this wallet's holdings); set it for external inflows (BTC: bitcoin | lightning; inbound USDT: its source network).

network.description: DESTINATION network of `to` (default liquid). e.g. lightning for a BOLT11 payout, ethereum/tron/… for an external stablecoin delivery.

to.description: Asset to convert TO: DEPIX, USDT, LBTC (L-BTC), BTC or USDC.

name: wallet_quote

routes.description: EVERY candidate route with chained estimates — the agent compares and chooses; the SDK never ranks.

available.description: false when a leg's swap provider is not creating swaps right now — wallet_convert refuses this route. Check it BEFORE comparing estimates. Unrelated to funds already in flight, which still claim and refund.

custodial.description: true iff ANY leg transits a custodial provider (SideShift) — signalled, never gated (G4).

estimate_complete.description: true when every leg produced an estimate (the chain is complete).

estimated_fee_total_sats.description: Sum of leg fees when every leg reported one in the SAME asset; otherwise null.

estimated_received_sats.description: Final estimated receipt in 8-decimal base units of `to` (string), or null when incomplete.

hops.description: Number of legs (multi-hop routes execute sequentially behind a crash-safe plan).

id.description: Stable route id — pass it to wallet_convert as `route` to execute this candidate.

custodial.description: true only for SideShift legs — funds transit their custody (G4).

estimated_fee_sats.description: Estimated leg fee in base units of fee_asset, or null.

estimated_received_sats.description: Estimated leg output in 8-decimal base units of `to` (string), or null when unavailable.

fee_asset.description: Asset the fee is denominated in, or null when unknown.

note.description: Why an estimate is missing / any caveat.

provider.description: Provider executing this leg: sideswap | boltz | sideshift.

notes.description: Per-leg caveats (missing estimators, mixed fee assets, …).

title: Quote conversion routes
